title: Battle Motors, Inc.: CRANE/TRANSMISSIONS (891 affected)
summary: THE TRANSMISSION RANGE SELECTOR PAD WILL INDICATE A DRIVE RANGE WHEN THE TRANSMISSION IS ACTUALLY IN NEUTRAL.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WINNEBAGO/SPARE TIRE CARRIER (10,590 affected)
summary: THE SPARE TIRE CARRIER HOIST COMPONENTS CAN BECOME LOOSE WHILE TRAVELING AND ALLOW THE SPARE TIRE TO MOVE FROM ITS STORED POSITION TO THE ROAD SURFACE.

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: FERRARI/ABS BRAKES (346 affected)
summary: THE ELECTRIC MOTOR WHICH DRIVES THE ANTI-LOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS) HYDRAULIC PUMP DOES NOT FUNCTION AFTER A PERIOD OF OPERATION.

title: IC CORPORATION: AMTRAN/HANDRAILS (2,480 affected)
summary: CERTAIN CLOTHING ARTICLES SUCH AS DRAW STRINGS CAN BECOME LODGED IN THE FORWARD HANDRAILS AT THE BUS DOORS WHEN A PERSON IS EXITING THE BUS.

title: redundant NEW FLYER OF AMERICA, INC.: NEW FLYER/ISRINGHAUSEN/SEATS (52 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION: BUSES EQUIPPED WITH ISRINGHAUSEN SEATS IN THE DRIVER POSITION.  TWO WELDS LOCATED ON THE BACK REST ADJUSTMENT SIDE OF THE SEAT FRAME DID NOT MEET THE MANUFACTURER'S SPECIFICATIONS.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/POWER MIRROR (39,000 affected)
summary: THE ELECTRICAL CONTACTS IN THE POWER MIRROR SWITCH CAN ACCUMULATE ROAD SALT DUE TO WATER ENTERING INTO THE SWITCH.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: VOLKSWAGEN/WINNEBAGO/FUEL TANK (201 affected)
summary: DURING THE INSTALLATION OF THE CAMPER EQUIPMENT, AN IMPROPERLY ADJUSTED POWER TOOL DRILL BIT PUNCTURED THE FUEL TANK VAPOR CONTAINER.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/WASHER/WIPER SWITCH (349,331 affected)
summary: SOME OF THESE VEHICLES HAVE A STRAINED OR SEPARATED WASHER/WIPER SWITCH POWER FEED WIRE.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: THOMAS BUILT/POWER SUPPLY (1,800 affected)
summary: THE NUT THAT SECURES THE VEHICLE'S MAIN POWER SUPPLY CAN LOOSEN CAUSING LOSS OF CONTACT.

title: ROSTRA PRECISION CONTROLS, INC.: ROSTRA/CRUISE CONTROL (25,108 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  AFTERMARKET CRUISE CONTROL UNITS SOLD BY AUDIOVOX, MOSS MOTORS, S&S AUTOMOTIVE AND WARSHAWSKY.  THESE AFTERMARKET CRUISE CONTROL UNITS CAN ACCELERATE ABOVE THE INTENDED SET SPEED.

title: CARRARO NORTH AMERICA: CARRARO/AXLES (182 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  AXLES USED AS REPLACEMENT EQUIPMENT FOR MARMON-HERRINGTON ALL WHEEL DRIVE CONVERSION KITS.  ALSO USED AS ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT IN CERTAIN ELDORADO NATIONAL BUSES.   AN INCORRECT WELDING MATERIAL WAS USED TO JOIN THE AXLE TUBE TO THE AXLE YOKE.

title: COUNTRY COACH INC: COUNTRY COACH/AUXILLIARY GENERATOR (17 affected)
summary: THE  "O" RINGS OF THE REGULATOR ASSEMBLY IN THE ONAN EMERALD AND MARQUIS BRAND GENERATOR SETS CAN WEAKEN AND BREAK WHEN EXPOSED TO HIGH AMBIENT TEMPERATURES.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: THOMAS BUILT/FMVSS 121 (55 affected)
summary: THESE BUSES WITH GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT RATINGS (GVWR) OF 36,200, DO NOT MEET THE BRAKE SIZE AND POWER REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD (FMVSS) NO. 121, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS,"  FOR VEHICLES OF THAT GVWR.

title: Capacity of Texas: CAPACITY OF TEXAS/BACK UP LIGHT SWITCH (160 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  THESE VEHICLES WERE BUILT FOR THE U. S. POSTAL SERVICE.  THE CONTROL SWITCH FOR THE BACK-UP LIGHTS WERE OMITTED DURING ASSEMBLY.

title: DIRECTED ELECTRONICS, INC.: DIRECTED ELECTRONICS/REMOTE START UNITS (200,000 affected)
summary: IMPROPERLY INSTALLED REMOTE START UNITS CAN PERMIT REMOTE ENGINE START WHILE THE VEHICLE IS IN GEAR.

title: Utilimaster Corporation: UTILIMASTER/HOOD (3,132 affected)
summary: WHEN THE VEHICLE IS BEING DRIVEN, THE FORCE OF THE WIND AGAINST THE HOOD CAN FORCE THE HOOD BEHIND THE BUMPER ALLOWING THE HOOD TO DROP.  THIS REDUCES THE TENSION ON THE TWO RUBBER HOLD-DOWNS WHICH THEN BECOME LOOSE.

title: BUELL-out of business: BUELL/FRONT BRAKE LINE HOSE (505 affected)
summary: THE FRONT BRAKE LINE HOSE CAN KINK DURING FRONT BRAKE ACTION.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: VOLVO HEAVY TRUCK/CAB ENTRY (1,928 affected)
summary: WARNING LABELS IDENTIFYING THE CLIMBING SEQUENCE AND PROCESS WERE OMITTED.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/ENGINE COOLING FAN (75,200 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES ARE ORIGINALLY SOLD OR CURRENTLY REGISTERED IN THE FOLLOWING STATES: ALASKA, IOWA, MINNESOTA, NEBRASKA, NORTH DAKOTA, AND SOUTH DAKOTA.  THE VEHICLES INVOLVED ARE 1992-1994 TEMPO/TOPAZ VEHICLES WITH 3.0L ENGINES; 1994 TEMPO/TOPAZ WITH 2.3L ENGINES; 1992-1995 TAURUS/SABLE WITH 3.8L ENGINES; 1994-1995 TAURUS/SABLE WITH 3.0L ENGINES AND 1992-1994 LINCOLN CONTINENTAL VEHICLES WITH 3.8L ENGINES. DURING HIGH WINDS, HEAVY, BLOWING AND DRIFTING SNOW, AND LOW TEMPERATURES, THE ENGINE COOLING FAN CAN BECOME BLOCKED OR FROZEN WITH SNOW.  THE FAN MOTOR MAY NOT ROTATE AND COULD OVERHEAT.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/THROTTLE CONTROL (212,700 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH 3.8L ENGINES AND ORIGINALLY SOLD OR CURRENTLY REGISTERED IN THE FOLLOWING STATES:  ALASKA, COLORADO, IOWA, IDAHO, ILLINOIS, INDIANA, KANSAS, MASSACHUSETTS, MAINE, MICHIGAN, MINNESOTA, MISSOURI, MONTANA, NORTH DAKOTA, NEBRASKA, NEW HAMPSHIRE, NEW YORK, OHIO, PENNSYLVANIA, SOUTH DAKOTA, VERMONT, WISCONSIN, AND WYOMING.  WATER CAN ACCUMULATE WITHIN THE SPEED CONTROL CABLE CONDUIT.  IF ENOUGH WATER ACCUMULATES, IT COULD FREEZE WITHIN A LOW AREA OF THE CABLE ROUTING WHEN EXPOSED TO A LONG TERM COLD SOAK AT TEMPERATURES AT LEAST SEVERAL DEGREES BELOW FREEZING.

title: Hyundai Motor America: HYUNDAI/WINDSHIELD WIPER MOTOR (74,965 affected)
summary: THE WINDSHIELD WIPER MOTOR CIRCUIT BREAKER ELECTRICAL CONTACTS WERE CONTAMINATED DURING ASSEMBLY.
